messages.text: I'm preparing Beaconpath Technologies' closing note for the failed launch-page publishing. My draft says, “Publishing recovered, so we'll close the case and apply the standard 10% service credit.” I was relying on the accepted Restore Point exercise, yesterday's publishing report and an older commercial handoff summary for that wording. Can someone check whether this is a fair account of what happened and what we should tell Anika?
For Emre's handoff, should I leave the individual biography destination empty? The destination we discussed for the Keystonemark card is the team index.
Yes, leave that field empty. We have the proposed team-index destination, but no individual biography target to put in the handoff.

I'll put the response-close hook and file-read cleanup together in the download-handler sketch. I'll also label the observed result as server-side completion so the sketch doesn't imply confirmed receipt.
That covers the question we discussed. Keep the prepared export's lifetime separate in the sketch too. Lucas has the next pass.
